themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying their demands for policies that prioritize native-born citizens over immigrants in public services, housing, and welfare. This theme is particularly strong in Spain, Italy, and Sweden, where Vox, Lega, and Sverigedemokraterna are leading the charge, often in coalition negotiations with mainstream conservative parties.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in public healthcare and housing, using it as a condition for coalition support in regional governments like Valencia and Andalusia.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega pushes for housing policies favoring locals, while Fratelli d'Italia aligns with EU migration pacts but emphasizes national sovereignty in welfare distribution.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Advocates for stricter immigration controls and prioritizing Swedish citizens in public services, influencing the national government's policies.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposes limiting welfare benefits for immigrants and prioritizing Norwegian citizens in public housing and services.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella criticizes immigration policies and demands stricter controls, framing it as a national priority issue in France.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina's libertarian president Javier Milei faces plummeting approval ratings due to economic struggles, corruption scandals, and internal conflicts within his party, La Libertad Avanza. This theme is echoed in right-wing media in Spain, the U.S., and Italy, where Milei's outsider image is being re-evaluated.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's approval rating drops to 33% due to economic policies, corruption scandals, and internal party conflicts, with key figures like Karina Milei and Santiago Caputo vying for influence.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes Milei's economic policies and corruption scandals, framing his government as unstable and ineffective.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Right-wing media highlights Milei's struggles as a cautionary tale for libertarian governance, with some figures distancing themselves from his policies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian right-wing media contrasts Milei's challenges with Meloni's stability, using it to critique libertarian economic models.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are making significant gains in local and regional elections across Europe, particularly in Germany, Italy, and Spain. This theme highlights the growing electoral influence of parties like AfD, Vox, and Lega, often at the expense of mainstream conservative and centrist parties.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD leads polls in multiple German states, with 69% of Germans expecting the party to win a state premiership in upcoming elections.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega and Fratelli d'Italia make gains in local elections, with Lega pushing for an early party congress to address internal divisions.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox secures key coalition deals in regional governments, such as in Extremadura and Castilla y León, often sidelining mainstream conservative parties.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Sverigedemokraterna consolidates its influence in local governments, particularly in regions like Klippan where it was denied party funding.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal divisions, leadership challenges, and defections. This theme is particularly prominent in Poland, Hungary, the UK, France, and Argentina, where parties like PiS, Fidesz, Reform UK, RN, and La Libertad Avanza are facing infighting and leadership crises.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS faces internal strife between hardliners like Czarnek and moderates like Morawiecki, with Kaczyński struggling to maintain control.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz faces defections and internal criticism, with PM Péter Magyar positioning himself as a reformer against Orbán's legacy.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK faces internal strife over controversial candidates, leadership challenges, and competition from rival far-right parties like Restore Britain.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN faces internal divisions over leadership and policy, with Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella differing on key issues like pensions.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's party faces internal conflicts between factions led by Karina Milei, Santiago Caputo, and Martín Menem, with defections and public disputes.

themes.title: EU and NATO tensions over Ukraine and Ebola
themes.blurb: Tensions between far-right governments and EU/NATO institutions are escalating over issues like Ukraine's EU accession, military aid to Ukraine, and the Ebola outbreak in Africa. This theme is particularly strong in Italy, Poland, and Hungary, where parties like Fratelli d'Italia, PiS, and Fidesz are clashing with EU leaders over these issues.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government faces EU criticism over defense spending and Ukraine's EU accession, with Lega opposing military aid to Ukraine.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS and President Nawrocki clash with Ukraine over historical issues, threatening to revoke Zelensky's Order of the White Eagle.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's PM Péter Magyar refuses to send weapons to Ukraine, defying NATO expectations and maintaining Orbán's policy.

countries.name: 🇪🇺 EU Institutions
countries.note: EU leaders criticize far-right governments for undermining Ukraine's EU accession and failing to address the Ebola outbreak effectively.
